brief.headline: Putin talks up advances as Ukrainian drones hit refineries
brief.lead: Channels amplified an extensive Putin briefing claiming gains across all fronts and rejecting ceasefire proposals, while sentiment soured sharply over a coordinated Ukrainian drone campaign on Russian refineries and fuel shortages. Unusually, the same channels ran heavy criticism of official Russian media for downplaying the war.

developments.title: Putin frontline briefing amplified across channels
developments.body: Multiple channels relayed a detailed Putin update claiming Russian advances in all directions, movement toward Slavyansk, breached fortifications by the Center group, and that liberating Donbas and 'Novorossiya' remains required. He called Ukrainian ceasefire offers 'unacceptable' and said such proposals come from the losing side (channel framing, MoD/Kremlin-sourced).

developments.title: Ukrainian drone strikes on refineries drive sentiment down
developments.body: Channels reported a 'coordinated' Ukrainian drone campaign against Russian refineries, with a 20,000+ sq m fire at the Slavyansk-on-Kuban refinery, one killed in Krasnodar, and claims of fuel production losses and regional shortages. Russian MoD claimed 213+ drones intercepted overnight (unconfirmed). Mood on this topic swung to -89 (down 39).

developments.title: Claimed captures of Novoseloka and Pisantsy
developments.body: Channels claimed Russia's Vostok group and 38th/36th brigades took Novoseloka (eastern Zaporizhzhia, toward Orekhovsk) and Pisantsy plus Novoskelyvatoe in the Dnipropetrovsk direction, alongside clearing near Rai-Aleksandrovka and Konstantinovka (channel/MoD claims, unconfirmed).

developments.title: 'Citadel' air defense system unveiled against drones
developments.body: Several channels promoted Russia's new short-range 'Citadel' air defense system with programmable ammunition to protect critical infrastructure from drone attacks — driving Russia-internal sentiment to +75. Timing aligns with fuel-infrastructure vulnerability messaging.

developments.title: Sharp criticism of Russian media and authorities
developments.body: Rybar and Two Majors ran a critical cluster: federal media downplaying casualties and failing to attribute infrastructure damage to Ukrainian strikes, and authorities prosecuting civilians who film drone strikes. Two Majors and Sladkov also faulted absent layered air defense and poor dispersal/ammo storage discipline.

developments.title: Contested Kinburn Spit and amphibious operation warnings
developments.body: Channels disputed a Ukrainian claim to have taken Kinburn Spit, citing video of Russians holding positions, while simultaneously warning of a Ukrainian special-forces amphibious operation preparing against the peninsula (channel claims, unconfirmed).

narrative_watch.title: Self-criticism of Kremlin information management
narrative_watch.body: Prominent milbloggers openly accuse official media of downplaying the war and authorities of suppressing drone-strike footage, a recurring frustration frame distinct from frontline cheerleading.

narrative_watch.title: 'Ceasefire = enemy weakness' framing
narrative_watch.body: Channels echo Putin that Ukrainian ceasefire proposals are unacceptable and signal the losing side, reinforcing a no-negotiation posture even amid fuel-infrastructure pressure.

narrative_watch.title: Western AI-surveillance dystopia motif
narrative_watch.body: Rybar pushes stories on UK police 'risk scores' and Pentagon AI targeting to portray the West as authoritarian and technocratic, a values-contrast narrative.

mood_lines.text: Buoyant (+75); claimed captures of Novoseloka, Pisantsy and Konstantinovka-area gains, amplified by Putin's all-fronts advance narrative.
Sharply negative (-89, down 39) over coordinated drone hits on refineries, Slavyansk fire, fuel shortages and a Kherson civilian bus fleet claim.
Positive; claimed strikes on Nikolaev special-ops training base, 10+ fuel stations and Zaporizhzhia fuel complex, framed as effective strategy.
Strongly positive (+75) driven by 'Citadel' air defense unveiling, relaxed rifle rules and Putin's societal-unity messaging.
Negative (-50); AI-surveillance stories, US-Iran escalation, EU curbs on Ukrainian draft-age men and mocked Mazepa monument plan.
Uniformly negative (-100); media downplaying war, prosecution of filmers, and command failures on air defense and dispersal discipline.

flag_texts.title: Fuel-strike anxiety deepens (-89, down 39)
flag_texts.body: Sentiment on Ukrainian strikes fell sharply as channels reported a coordinated drone campaign against refineries, the Slavyansk-on-Kuban fire, and admitted fuel shortages affecting millions — with even Putin acknowledging Crimea's 70K-ton monthly fuel need.

flag_texts.title: Russia-internal mood jumps to +75
flag_texts.body: A rare strong positive swing driven by the 'Citadel' anti-drone system rollout, parliament cutting the rifle-ownership waiting period from five to three years, and Putin's unity messaging.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation and Putin-criticism watchlists quiet
flag_texts.body: Mobilisation surfaced only via Belgorod's eight new BARS battalions, not federal call-ups, and direct criticism targeted media and army command rather than Putin, who was quoted approvingly throughout.
